description: OrbitPage helps people read, edit, preview, publish, and restore their hosted web page from ChatGPT. It keeps changes tied to the connected OAuth workspace, shows a proposal before edits are applied, can publish an approved revision, and exposes publication status plus retained versions.

defaultPrompt: Show my page, summarize its current content, and tell me whether it has unpublished changes.
Preview a clearer profile description while keeping my links and theme unchanged. Do not apply it yet.
Show my unpublished changes and, after I confirm, publish the exact current revision.
